reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Expanding an integrated and comprehensive approach to Malaria control in the Democratic Republic of Timor Leste - Timor-Leste (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Timor-Leste, Malaria, Ministry of Health of the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste (MOH)This program has the following goals: To eliminate malaria transmision in Timor Leste by end 2021. The objectives of this program are: To interrupt indigenous malaria transmission by the end of 2021. To maintain zero mortality due to indigenous malaria. To prevent re-introduction of malaria in districts that have already interrupted indigenous malaria transmission
